reviews.t: Definitely works though it is a THICK formula!

Pros: -It’s easy to apply. -It’s odorless. -Has it’s own wand. -Does work with consistent use.  Cons: -Very thick. Has a glue-like consistency. -Dries crusty and clings to lashes and skin.  All in all, it

claims.text: Many reviewers report that the serum works, making their eyelashes longer and fuller, sometimes filling in bald spots.
Several reviewers say the product did not work for them, seeing no growth even after weeks or months of use.
Some reviewers praise the company's customer service, noting they made things right after defects or complaints.
A few reviewers mention the product does not irritate their eyes, while others report watering or burning.
Some reviewers complain about little or no product in the tube and a thick or inconsistent formula.
